description: One page of an airport's departures on record for one airport-local day, departed and cancelled flights included (coverage on_record: the flights GADUIN has a record of, not the airport's full schedule). Each physical flight appears once with its codeshares, ordered by scheduled departure (unknown schedules last), with destination, scheduled, estimated and recorded departure in UTC, status, delay in minutes, verdict (delayed means more than late_threshold_minutes plus the airport's taxi_allowance_minutes) and a link to its flight page. Each flight belongs to exactly one date: the airport-local date of its scheduled departure, whenever it actually left (with no scheduled time, the date of its recorded departure), so days add up without double counting; for the airport's current day only, a flight that left before local midnight ahead of a schedule after it is listed once that day has ended. While next_cursor is not null, call again with the same airport and cursor set to it to read the rest of the day. total counts the day's flights at each read, so a flight added between pages can change it.

airport.description: Airport IATA code (e.g. LHR) or ICAO code (e.g. EGLL). An IATA code works for airports with a page on gaduin.com; otherwise give the ICAO code.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, to read the next page; give the same airport (and date, if given) with it. Omit for the first page.

date.description: Airport-local date YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 400 days. Defaults to the airport's today.

limit.description: Max flights per page (1-500). Defaults to 100.

name: get_airport_departures
title: Airport departures board
